reviews.title: Real reviews from real orders.
reviews.lede: A sample of recent comments, shared by customers who already received their order.

items.name: Carla M.
items.body: I ordered the Ninja Foodi grill for the kitchen and I'm thrilled with it. It arrived well packed and works exactly as they described over WhatsApp.

items.name: Rafael T.
items.body: The Xbox controller arrived quickly and in perfect condition. I give it 4 stars because I would have liked more color options, though the quality matched what you'd find in stores.

items.name: Yamilet R.
items.body: I bought the CHAE-U set for my mom and it exceeded what I expected. The packaging is beautiful and every product smells wonderful.

items.name: Pedro A.
items.body: The KitchenAid mixer arrived exactly on the date they confirmed over WhatsApp. The final price beat the big stores I checked beforehand.

items.name: Diana S.
items.body: The PS5 works perfectly and everything synced up easily. I give it 4 stars because it took a couple of days longer than expected, though they kept me updated the whole way.

items.name: Manuel G.
items.body: I've used the Healena gel for three weeks now and the scar already looks smoother. Really happy with the follow-up they gave me after the purchase.

items.name: Lorena F.
items.body: The Ninja coffee maker is exactly what I was looking for at the office. The service felt very personal — they walked me through everything over WhatsApp before confirming the order.

items.name: Andrés V.
items.body: The DualZone air fryer cooks evenly in both baskets. Good buying experience, with clear updates throughout shipping.

items.name: Katherine P.
items.body: I ordered the Xbox Series X as a gift for my son and everything arrived complete, with invoice and warranty. Highly recommended for gift orders.

items.name: Julio C.
items.body: The Samsung TV looks spectacular in the living room. I'm taking off one star only because confirming the available color took a bit longer, but the end result was worth it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Global Beyond LLC
privacy.metaDescription: How Global Beyond LLC collects, uses, and protects the information submitted through this website.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information Global Beyond LLC (“we,” “us”) collects through globalbeyondllc.com, why, and what you can do about it. We wrote it to match exactly what this website does — nothing more.

p: The only information we collect is what you choose to give us: your name, and an email address and/or phone number, and the message you write, when you submit the contact form on this site.

This site does not use cookies, does not run analytics or advertising trackers, and does not build a profile of visitors. The one thing your browser stores locally is a small technical flag that remembers you already chose a language, so you are not redirected twice in the same visit; it contains no personal information and is not sent to us.

We use the information you submit for one purpose: to read your message and reply to you — about the catalog, an order, or whatever you wrote to us about. We do not use it for marketing, do not build mailing lists from it, and do not sell or rent it to anyone.

Submitting the form sends your message to us by email through Resend, the service that delivers it to our inbox. Resend processes the message only to deliver it and does not use it for its own purposes. We do not share your information with any other third party.

If you write to us on WhatsApp or Instagram instead of the form, that conversation is subject to WhatsApp's and Instagram's own privacy practices, not this one — those are Meta products and we do not control how they handle data on their platforms.

We keep messages only for as long as we need them to respond to you and, where relevant, to keep a record of an order or request. We do not have an automated retention schedule yet; if you would like your information deleted, contact us and we will remove it.

You can ask us what information we have about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, at any time — write to us through the contact form or WhatsApp and we will handle it personally, usually within a business day.
This site is intended for businesses and individuals seeking retail or wholesale products, not for children. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 13.
If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above. Continued use of the site after a change means you accept the updated policy.
Questions about this policy can go to the same place as everything else — the contact form on this site, or WhatsApp.

terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of globalbeyondllc.com, operated by Global Beyond LLC, a limited liability company registered in the State of Florida, United States. By using this site, you agree to them.

p: This site presents Global Beyond LLC and lets you request our current product catalog, ask about retail or wholesale orders, and reach us directly. It is not a store: nothing here can be purchased directly through the site, and no order, price, or availability is final until we confirm it to you individually.

We keep the content on this site accurate to the best of our knowledge, but our product selection changes over time, and pricing, availability, and shipping details are confirmed per request, not published here. Nothing on this site should be treated as a binding offer.

Use this site for its intended purpose: learning about Global Beyond LLC and reaching us. Do not attempt to disrupt it, scrape it at scale, submit false or malicious information through the contact form, or use it to distribute unlawful content.

The Global Beyond LLC name, logo, and the text, photographs, and design on this site belong to Global Beyond LLC or are used with permission. You may view and share this site's pages; you may not reproduce the logo or brand assets for your own use without asking us first.

This site links to WhatsApp and Instagram, both operated by Meta, and to email. Once you leave this site through one of those links, that platform's own terms apply — we are not responsible for their content or practices.
This site is provided as is. We do our best to keep it accurate and available, but we do not guarantee it will be error-free, uninterrupted, or permanently accessible.
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida, United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
We may update these terms as the site and the business evolve. The date above reflects the latest revision.
